object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On the clean machine, install the previous release, configure an MCP client to start %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Mellon\mellon-mcp.exe, then run the new release's Windows installer. Expected: no page asks for a folder and the new release is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Mellon; 'mellon-mcp.exe --version' and the About dialog report the new release number; the MCP client connects with its configuration unchanged; the installed apps list holds Mellon once.
